audit_items.proof_trace: All invest-path signature checks (LegionAbstractSale._verifyInvestSignature, LegionCapitalRaise._verifyValidPosition, LegionPreLiquidApprovedSale._verifyValidPosition, LegionPositionManager._verifyTransferSignature) use OZ ECDSA.recover() with toEthSignedMessageHash() and compare directly against the legionSigner address sourced from LegionAddressRegistry. All abi.encodePacked fields are fixed-length, eliminating collision risk. No invest code path bypasses the check, and with Solidity 0.8.30 / OZ v5.x, recover() reverts on malformed signatures, preventing the address(0) bypass.
